capabilities.description: Registers the uploaded contract (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) as the controlled source of record, stores revisions with provenance and hashes, and provides retrieval and search across the register.

Builds Interim Payment Certificates from measured quantities against the BOQ items (P1-P5, E1-E5) at their stated rates, applying Clause 14.3 retention of 5% of each certificate and splitting release at Taking-Over and end of the Defects Notification Period.

Tracks the 730-day Time for Completion from Commencement Date per Clause 8.2 and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% under Clause 8.7, with the performance security at 10% per Clause 4.2 held as a reference figure.
Captures inspection and test plan (ITP) records against BOQ work sections, holds them in a review-and-approval workflow with evidence attached, and provides an auditable trail of QA sign-offs.
Answers clause and entitlement questions by grounding responses in the registered contract and BOQ documents, refusing where the source documents do not support an answer.
Presents claim status, retention balances, delay-damages exposure, QA/ITP completion, and register health on a single project dashboard for the contract administration team.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that manages progress claims against the uploaded BOQ, tracks delay damages under the contract's time and damages clauses, captures QA/ITP records, and maintains a controlled document register with the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record. It serves the project's contract administrators, quantity surveyors, QA engineers, and document-control staff.
